entries.topic: Jericho after a rescued lost fight
originals: Jericho on a rescued loss?
Whether a rescued lost fight (DON'T SHOOT, John or Simon saves him) shows a Jericho arrow.
entries.question: Charge, lose the fight, choose DON'T SHOOT, and John (or Simon) saves Markus: is there a Jericho ▲▲ (and public opinion ▲▲) on top of the loss's Jericho ▼▼ (yes/no)?
entries.why: Template's DON'T SHOOT says only 'See SACRIFICE.' (SACRIFICE carries PO and Jericho LargeUp); Relationship_Stat lists the John and Simon sacrifice endings under Jericho large increase. Benchmark applies only the loss's Jericho −2.

originals: Second ATTACK?

ATTACK here goes straight into the fight…
entries.question: After a first STAND GROUND, does choosing ATTACK ask CONFIRM / ABANDON again (yes/no)?
entries.why: Template pointers 'See ATTACK' (after STAND GROUND) and 'See ATTACK > CHARGE' (after ABANDON) are ambiguous; 'ATTACK > CHARGE' does not exist. Benchmark goes straight to the fight.

originals: North's follow-up loop?
Whether North's follow-up prompt repeats after CURIOUS or UNDERSTANDING.
entries.question: After answering UNDERSTANDING to 'I don't wanna talk about it', does the same prompt come back so you can also pick TRUST (yes/no)?
entries.why: PowerPyx's recipe 'NORTH'S PAST > UNDERSTANDING > TRUST' implies two answers; the template shows one prompt. Each answer moves North, so a repeat adds arrows. Benchmark: one answer. The level check is read after the answer's arrow, which matches the template's order.

Which Capitol Park outcomes show each magazine on the roof.

entries.why: Android_Riot wiki: any successful store raid; Eastern Space Race wiki: store freed and violence; PowerPyx saw both only after a violent riot; commenter Rin saw the first after a peaceful one. Benchmark follows the wiki pages.

originals: "SIMON SURVIVED IN 'PUBLIC ENEMY'" for an unhurt Simon?
entries.answer: Yes for the sacrifice. PowerPyx: 'Simon escaped with you in The Stratford Tower or you left him behind on the roof (alive) but Connor didn't find him… positive (friendly)'. The reunion (SIMON SURVIVED > REUNITED IN JERICHO) is only for the left-behind Simon. ch28 uses simonReturned=leftOnRoof for the reunion and simonGood (any living Simon) for the sacrifice.

originals: Public opinion on a charge after standing?
entries.answer: The template puts PublicOpinion LargeDown only in the 'Win the fight' variant, with nothing on CHARGE/CONFIRM or a loss. The wiki agrees ('Winning the fight after choosing "charge"' ▼▼). STAND GROUND (+1) then a win (−2) nets −1, and a loss nets +1; George's 'zero' is a single comment.
entries.source: template ch28 CONFIRM variants; wiki ch28 Public Opinion
